title: Great for poaching newbies!
text:
Great for poaching newbies!. I've never made poached eggs before I got these. I watched a YouTube video to learn how to make them with these, because they don't come with instructions. (Hence the 4 stars).
I did spray with Pam before adding the raw egg, as they taught in the video I watched, and they didn't stick at all.
Best part? Dishwasher safe!
